# proxmox_sdn_vnet_firewall_options (Data Source)

Reads the firewall options of one SDN VNet from `/cluster/sdn/vnets/{vnet}/firewall/options`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_vnet_firewall_options" "app" {
  vnet = proxmox_sdn_vnet.app.vnet
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vnet` (String) VNet whose options are read.

### Read-Only

- `enable` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) VNet identifier.
- `log_level_forward` (String)
- `policy_forward` (String)
